fixture.core: Locally compiled src/Core.sol deployed at the test's canonical Core address; no fork or live-chain validation
fixture.router: Locally compiled test/LaunchTestRouter.sol; standard-ABI single-hop forwarding and settlement, with snapshot/revert quotes in the test harness; no deployed-router bytecode fixture
fixture.creator_fee_range: every uint64 0..18446744073709551615 inclusive for initialFee and finalFee (Q0.64; 2**64 - 1 is just under 100%, never exactly 100%); finalFee <= initialFee, else InvalidFeeSchedule; exactly 100% = 2**64 is not a uint64 and fails ABI decoding with empty revert data; see creator_fee_range
fixture.label: LOCAL FIXTURE VECTORS - not live evidence; numeric start margin is a local-reference proposal, not a live parameter; the creator fee ceiling is the uint64 maximum
fixture.quote_18: t0 order: plain 18-decimal test ERC-20 selected per launch at the top of the address space. t1 order: native ETH, address(0), the reference Base configuration; always token0, no code, no decimals(), no approvals.
fixture.quote_6: plain 6-decimal solady ERC-20 (DecimalsToken), selected per launch for math vectors only
fixture.fee_decay_rate_encoding: decayRateX32: uint64, unsigned Q32.32 ticks per second (2**32 = 1 tick/s). Any value is accepted; 0 is a flat fee. Half-life in seconds of the excess over finalFee = 2 * ln(2) / ln(1.000001) * 2**32 / decayRateX32 = 1386295.05426695565 * 2**32 / decayRateX32. rate for a half-life H: floor(1386295.05426695565... * 2**32 / H), computed with exact high-precision arithmetic (not binary floating point).
fixture.fee_schedule: initialFee for t <= 0 or decayRateX32 == 0; finalFee for t > MAX_DECAY_PRODUCT / decayRateX32 (integer division; MAX_DECAY_PRODUCT = (88722835 + 1) * 2**32 - 1 = 381061679028371455); otherwise m = floor(decayRateX32 * t / 2**32) and fee = finalFee + floor((initialFee - finalFee) * R / 2**128) with R = toFixed(tickToSqrtRatio(-m)), the compact (94-bit mantissa, rounded down) sqrt ratio of src/math/ticks.sol as a 64.128 integer. t = block timestamp - tradingStart in whole seconds. The operation order is normative; the saturation check must precede the helper call.

gas_note: In-test warm gas, t0 on the plain 18-decimal test ERC-20 quote and t1 on native ETH, through the periphery (create, claim) and the forwarding test locker (swaps), as logged by test_gas_vectors at this revision (forge 1.8.3, solc 0.8.33, via_ir, optimizer 9999999, evm osaka).

definitions.core_unbooked_dust: Per token: Core balance - position amount (rounded down) - creator fee ledger, accumulated over all swaps; raw units of that token. Unowned: not creator principal, not creator fees, unreachable by claims.
definitions.upper_bound_residue: Raw launch-token units the position held before the exhausting buy that the buy did not deliver when it stopped at the upper bound. Becomes Core unbooked dust: dust_after.token = dust_before.token + residue (asserted).

producer_proposal.why: Bounds the requested start to maxDelay after buildTime. Submission before expiry does not guarantee mining before start: late mining reverts atomically. No inclusion-latency guarantee.

claim_recipient_refusals.atomicity: both assets or neither; a reverting native recipient or a refused ERC-20 transfer rolls the ledger, principal and Core balances back; retry to another recipient pays both in full
claim_recipient_refusals.reentrancy: the ledger is moved onto the lock before Core pays; an owner contract re-entering claimFees during the payment claims zero

metadata.encoding: Canonical LibString.packOne: first byte length 1..31, next length bytes content, all remaining bytes zero
metadata.unit: bytes, not characters; UTF-8 is a consumer policy, not contract validation
metadata.note: LibString.packOne assumes memory padding; producers must explicitly zero the tail. No truncation.

collision.rule: CREATE2(extension, keccak256(abi.encode(controller,salt)), keccak256(LaunchToken.creationCode ++ abi.encode(bytes32 name,bytes32 symbol))); logo is excluded

fee_curve.note: Tick-rate schedule. Digests: SHA-256 chain h = sha256(h || fee as 8-byte big-endian) over the sampled seconds t = 0, step, 2*step, ..., last inclusive; all from the independent Python oracle (exact port of the tick table).
fee_curve.saturation_note: saturation_second = MAX_DECAY_PRODUCT / decayRateX32 is the last elapsed second computed through the helper; from the next second the fee is exactly finalFee. On the 50% -> 0.3% fixtures the floored excess is already zero earlier (rounding), so the two mechanisms coincide at the floor; a full-span excess (2**64 - 1 -> 0) still leaves 1 raw unit when the magnitude is exactly 88,722,835 at saturation_second, which is why the guard rather than a clamp to the minimum tick yields finalFee.

tick_steps.note: 1/4 tick/s: the fee steps every 4 s
floor(0.1 * 2**32), slightly below one tick per 10 s: first step at 11 s
default: 16 whole ticks per second, 1,386,295 after one day
a one-unit excess is gone after the first whole tick

oracle_error_bounds.note: Integer result minus the real-number F + (I - F) * 1.000001**(-(decayRateX32 / 2**32) * t / 2) at 150 digits, default 50% -> 0.3%, every second of the first hour then every 10 minutes to 30 days. The error is dominated by the whole-tick floor of m (one tick = 5e-7 of the excess), not by the helper (which is within a few units of 2**-128 of the real sqrt ratio) or the final floor.

consumer_default.note: 50% -> 0.3% with a one-day half-life of the excess: the consumer-side default; a creation parameter choice, not a contract constant. About 25.15% after one day, 12.73% after two, 0.69% after seven; the floor is approached, not scheduled.

decay_rate_rules: any uint64 decayRateX32 is accepted, including 0 (flat at initialFee) and 2**64 - 1 (finalFee from the first second)

max_rate.note: Launches created through ZeroSeedLaunchPeriphery.create at initialFee = 2**64 - 1 (no storage injection), finalFee = 0.3%, default one-day half-life rate 68913100933, traded at tradingStart. Exact input: net = floor(gross / 2**64), fee = gross - net = ceil(gross * (2**64 - 1) / 2**64). Exact output: paid = calc * 2**64, fee = paid - calc. Settled by the local test lockers against locally compiled Core; not live evidence.
max_rate.first_buy_note: The first whole-quote-unit buy is identical for the max -> 0.3% / default rate, max -> max / rate 1 and max -> 0 / rate 2**64 - 1 schedules (the rate at tradingStart is the initial rate in every case).
max_rate.trades_note: Actual maximum-rate fills on the final geometry; oneUnit buys net zero, exact output grosses up the input; see trade rows for exact amounts

exact_output_bounds.note: Bisection over the requested launch-token output on the pinned fixture: the last request that executes, the first that fails the signed int128 conversion of the fee-inclusive input (calc * 2**64 >= 2**127), and the first that fails the uint128 gross-up helper (calc >= 2**64). The last executable request has calc = 2**63 - 1 exactly. Every failed probe rolls back pool state, fee ledger, position liquidity and Core balances.
